Illustrative matters

Case Studies

Illustrative examples of the kind of matters handled. They are not records of actual clients or outcomes.

Criminal defence

Bail application after a late-night arrest

A family reaches the chamber at night after a relative is taken into custody. The FIR and custody papers are read the same night, the sections are explained plainly, and a bail application is prepared for the earliest hearing.
Recovery

Unpaid dues against a written agreement

A supplier delivered goods but payment was withheld for months. Invoices, delivery proof and bank entries are put in order and a legal notice sets a clear deadline before recovery proceedings.
Cheque dishonour

Notice after a returned cheque

A cheque towards loan repayment is returned unpaid. The bank memo is checked for dates, a demand notice is sent within the statutory period, and a complaint is drafted if payment is not made.
Consultation

Reviewing papers before signing

A first-time buyer is asked to sign a property agreement with penalty clauses. Each clause is explained, risky terms are flagged, and changes are set out in writing before anything is signed.

Free Case Consultation

Common questions

Before You Call

Can I call outside office hours?

Yes. The chamber is open 24 hours, so urgent matters such as an arrest or a police notice can be discussed at any time.

What should I bring to a first meeting?

Whatever you already have: an FIR copy, notices, agreements, receipts, cheques, bank statements or messages. Missing papers are not a reason to delay.

Which matters are handled?

Criminal and recovery matters, along with legal consultation and court representation. If a matter falls outside this focus, you will be told directly.

Where is the office located?

House No. 02A, Ground Floor, near Osho Homes, Wadhawa Nagar, Dhakoli, Zirakpur, Punjab 140604, close to Chandigarh and easily reached from the highway.

Will the situation be explained without legal jargon?

Yes. You are told what the law says, what the realistic options are and what each step is likely to involve.
